rv.q: I love CHORUS LINE, and (above paragraphs notwithstanding) I love MadKap's production of it – I will keep a close eye out for MadKap / Skokie productions!
If you've never seen A Chorus Line , or if you're a fan of the show like me, it's worth the trip to see this version even with certain technical aspects that get in the way.

Mell has put together a sterling cast of performers. There are a few that might not be shining examples of what the show requires, but for the most part, this is a production that is a great value for theater audiences.
Aside from a few minor gaffs as mentioned this show was great fun and very enjoyable.
